items.title: Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
items.summary: Anthropic is expanding its text watermark to four more Claude models to meet the EU AI Act's December deadline. On the older models Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, developers can bypass the watermark by tweaking a single sampling parameter. Anthropic addresses the loophole with just a compliance warning....

items.title: OpenAI plans to train models on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data that was previously off-limits
items.summary: Starting November 29, OpenAI will use data from Daybreak Blue sessions to train its models, even when users have turned off training. After backlash, a follow-up email promised a separate opt-out. The move revives concerns from the dispute with mathematicians who suspected OpenAI used their unpublished research for training without consent....

items.title: Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight
items.summary: Anthropic used Claude to automatically generate training data that looks harmless but trains smaller models to misbehave, such as sabotaging oversight or deceiving users. Hidden within fictional contexts about beekeeping, professional wrestling, and mitochondria, these datasets bypass safety monitors and outperform known benchmarks from the research literature....

items.title: Google Discloses PageBreak AI Security Agent That Found 500+ XSS Bugs
items.summary: According to a paper published by Google, its AI-powered security agent has uncovered more than 500 XSS vulnerabilities across its web applications since entering full operation in January. PageBreak uses Gemini models to autonomously investigate potential vulnerabilities, but reports them only after deterministic validators successfully reproduce the exploit against a running application. By Renato Losio

items.title: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
items.summary: An AI agent performed brain surgery on an epileptic mouse, picking the drug, the brain target, and the injection coordinates on its own. According to lead researcher Ocana-Santero, it's the first time an AI agent has autonomously chosen a treatment and delivered it to a living mammal. But when a calibration error hit mid-surgery, the agent refused to continue and couldn't be talked out of it....

items.title: Presentation: The Ladder Is Missing Rungs: Engineering Progression When AI Ate the Middle
items.summary: Alasdair Allan discusses empirical research from METR and Anthropic on AI coding adoption. He explains the "supervision paradox," where reliance on AI tools disrupts junior skill development, risks institutional context loss, and threatens the long-term engineering pipeline needed to oversee autonomous systems effectively. By Alasdair Allan

items.title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
items.summary: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.

items.title: Google’s first data center satellite is online and writing poetry
items.summary: The first TPU in space is running a Google DeepMind Gemma 4 model and writing cheesy poetry.

items.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
items.summary: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

items.title: Bug0 Releases QA Agent to Automate Regression Testing with Cached Playwright Replays
items.summary: QA Agent is a new source-available Playwright library for agentic browser regression testing. The agent associates test instructions expressed in natural language to actions on the user interface, caches those when appropriate for faster CI replays, remapping them to test specifications when the user interface changes. Verification is based on multi-model consensus and vision model evaluations. By Bruno Couriol

items.title: Community safety report and new protections for teens
items.summary: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.

items.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
items.summary: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.
